attributes.name: Flight Arrows
attributes.powers:
Display this card; you may not do this during an encounter. After doing so, if you have more than 2 cards that have the Ammunition trait displayed, recharge 1 of them.

While displayed, when you play a weapon that has the Bow trait, if you would recharge, discard, or bury it, you may instead keep it and perform the required action with this card.
